name: Discord
description: Trigger workflows from new Discord messages, members and threads, and send messages, reply in threads, react, pin or read channels and members from a step.

triggers.label: A message is posted in a channel
triggers.description: Fires once per new message in the channel or thread. Bot and system messages are skipped unless the connection includes them. Reading the text needs the Message Content intent.

env.name: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
env.description: From https://discord.com/developers/applications: open the application, Bot tab, Reset Token, and paste the token it shows once. Sent as `Authorization: Bot <token>`.
env.builderHint: A bot token, not an OAuth2 Bearer token. Reading message text needs the Message Content intent and listing members the Server Members intent, both under Privileged Gateway Intents on the same Bot page. A pasted "Bot " prefix is stripped.

env.name: DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID
env.description: Channel or thread id (Developer Mode → right-click → Copy Channel ID). Required by the message trigger; narrows the thread trigger to one parent channel.
env.builderHint: A snowflake, so keep it a string. A thread is a channel: point a second connection at the thread id to watch its replies.

env.name: DISCORD_GUILD_ID
env.description: Guild (server) id. Required by the member and thread triggers.
env.builderHint: Also a snowflake. Right-click the server name with Developer Mode on to copy it.

env.name: DISCORD_INCLUDE_BOTS
env.description: Deliver messages whose author is a bot, including this one’s. Off by default so a workflow that posts into the channel it watches does not loop.

env.name: DISCORD_INCLUDE_SYSTEM
env.description: Deliver joins, pins, boosts, thread notices and other messages nobody typed.

env.name: DISCORD_LOOKBACK_MINUTES
env.description: How far back the very first poll looks. Later polls continue from where the last one stopped.

env.name: DISCORD_MAX_PAGES
env.description: Pages of 100 messages or 1000 members one poll walks before leaving the rest for the next.

triggers.label: A member joins the server
triggers.description: Fires once per member who joined the guild since the last poll. Needs the Server Members intent.

actions.label: Send a message
actions.description: Post a message to a channel or thread, optionally as a reply and with embeds.

inputs.label: Channel
inputs.builderHint: Defaults to nothing: a step names the channel it posts to, which is often {{trigger.item.channel_id}}.

inputs.label: Message
inputs.description: Text, up to 2000 characters. Required unless embeds are given.
inputs.builderHint: Markdown as Discord renders it; mentions are <@userId>.

inputs.label: Embeds
inputs.description: A JSON array of up to 10 embed objects (title, description, url, color, fields, footer, image, thumbnail, author, timestamp).
inputs.builderHint: Needs the Embed Links permission to render. One object is taken as a single embed.

inputs.label: Reply to
inputs.description: Message id to reply to, from {{trigger.item.id}}.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as message_reference with fail_if_not_exists false, so a deleted target posts a plain message rather than failing.

actions.label: Reply in a thread
actions.description: Start a thread from a message, or use the one it already has, and post a reply in it.

inputs.label: Message
inputs.description: The message to thread from, from {{trigger.item.id}}.
inputs.builderHint: A thread shares its id with the source message, so a thread that already exists is found by this id.

inputs.label: Thread name
inputs.description: Thread name, 1 to 100 characters. Ignored when the thread already exists.

inputs.label: Reply
inputs.description: The reply to post in the thread, up to 2000 characters.

inputs.label: Auto-archive after
inputs.description: Minutes of inactivity before the thread archives: 60, 1440, 4320 or 10080. Defaults to 1440.
inputs.builderHint: Discord accepts only these four values; anything else is refused before the call.

outputs.description: Id of the thread, the same as the source message
Whether this call made the thread
Id of the reply posted in the thread

actions.label: Add a reaction
actions.description: React to a message with a Unicode or custom emoji.

inputs.label: Emoji
inputs.description: A Unicode emoji such as 👍, or name:id for a custom one.
inputs.builderHint: URL-encoded into the path; a pasted <:name:id> is reduced to name:id. Needs Read Message History and Add Reactions.

actions.label: Pin a message
actions.description: Pin a message in its channel. Pinning one already pinned is a no-op.

inputs.label: Message
inputs.builderHint: Needs the Pin Messages permission; a channel holds at most 250 pins and Discord answers 30003 past that.

actions.label: List channels
actions.description: The channels of a guild, sorted by position. Threads are not included.

inputs.label: Channel type
inputs.description: Keep only this type: 0 text, 2 voice, 4 category, 5 announcement, 13 stage, 15 forum, 16 media.
inputs.builderHint: Discord’s channel type numbers; blank keeps every type.

outputs.description: One entry per channel: id, name, type, parentId, position, topic, nsfw

actions.label: Get a channel
actions.description: Read one channel or thread by id.

outputs.description: Guild the channel belongs to, or null for a DM
Category or parent channel id, or null
Id of the newest message, or null
Thread metadata for a thread, or null
Messages in a thread, or null
Members of a thread, or null

actions.label: Get a server member
actions.description: Read one member of a guild, with their nickname, roles and join date.

inputs.label: User
inputs.builderHint: Needs no privileged intent, unlike listing members. 10007 Unknown Member when the user is not in the guild.

outputs.description: Nickname in this guild, or null
When they started boosting, or null
Whether membership screening is still pending
End of a timeout, or null
Whether the user is a bot
